newsitem.title: HONG KONG: HK 28-day average accepted yield 5.71 percent.
newsitem.headline: HK 28-day average accepted yield 5.71 percent.

text.p: The average yield of 28-day Exchange Fund bills at Tuesday's tender was 5.71 percent, the Hong Kong Monetary Authority (HKMA) said.
This compares with an average accepted yield of 5.44 percent at the last tender and one-month HIBOR of 6.62500 percent at 0300 GMT.
Bids for the HK$5.0 billion issue were HK$7.87 billion against HK$9.8 billion at the last tender.
The average accepted yield for 91-day Exchange Fund bills was 5.73 percent against 5.44 percent at the last tender and three-month HIBOR of 6.6667 percent.
Bids for the HK$2.0 billion issue were HK$4.35 billion against HK$5.74 billion at the last tender.
The average accepted yield for one-year Exchange Fund Notes was 5.96 percent against 12-month HIBOR of 6.80729 percent.
Bids for the HK$500 million issue were HK$2.01 billion.
